units.source_text: 大概为了避免积雪，顺着客栈的墙临时挖了一条小沟，将浴池溢出的热水引到大门口，汇成一个浅浅的水潭。

en.t: Probably to keep snow from piling up, a temporary little ditch had been dug along the inn wall, carrying the hot water overflowing from the bath to the entrance, where it gathered into a shallow pool.

units.source_text: 一只壮硕的黑色秋田狗蹲在那里的一块踏石上，久久地舔着热水。

en.t: A sturdy black Akita dog crouched there on a stepping stone, licking the hot water for a long time.

units.source_text: 门口晾晒着成排客用滑雪板，那是从库房里刚搬出来的，还发出轻微的霉味。

en.t: Rows of skis for guests were drying at the entrance; they had just been brought out from storage and still gave off a faint moldy smell.

units.source_text: 这种霉味也被蒸气冲淡了。就连从杉树枝头掉落下来的雪，在公共浴池房顶上遇到热气，也融化变形了。

en.t: The steam softened even that moldy smell. Even the snow that fell from the tips of the cedar branches, meeting the heat on the roof of the public bathhouse, melted and lost its shape.
